testsuite.name: E - Rasan soran - Storage navigation and accessibility
testsuite.details:
Tester: Rasan soran (Member 5, E). SECJ3343 Project 1, TaskFlow main@5133a6c. Scope: reload persistence; storage recovery/failure; warning behavior; navigation/title; responsive sidebar; dialog focus/name; toast timing/semantics. A owns creation/text limits/draft cancellation, B editing/deletion, C enums/dates/status/counts, D querying. Shared actions are setup only.

Basis: README.md Storage, Requirements traceability, Behaviour notes and Exact messages, plus implementing functions cited by each code-derived requirement. Cases are designs, initially Not Run; no execution or peer review claimed.

Use a disposable Chrome profile at http://localhost:5173. Only seed/remove taskflow_tasks and taskflow_tasks_backup in that profile. Never clear personal browser data. For storage functions inaccessible through normal UI, cases marked UNIT HARNESS use DevTools Console on Vite, dynamically import /src/utils/storage.js, replace window.localStorage with a stub, and call loadTasks/saveTasks/resetStorage directly. This is a unit harness, not browser-level fault injection. To simulate failed UI writes without reload, patch Storage.prototype.setItem to throw a QuotaExceededError before the action; use the disposable profile. For storage fixtures define const validTask=(id,o={})=>({id,title:"Task "+id,description:"",priority:"Medium",status:"To Do",dueDate:"",createdAt:"2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z",updatedAt:"2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z",...o}); const seedTasks=a=>localStorage.setItem("taskflow_tasks",JSON.stringify(a));. To inspect normalized loader objects use const m=await import("/src/utils/storage.js"); console.log(m.loadTasks().tasks). For read faults use UNIT HARNESS: const m=await import("/src/utils/storage.js"); Object.defineProperty(window,"localStorage",{configurable:true,value:{getItem(){throw Error("blocked")},setItem(){throw Error("blocked")},removeItem(){throw Error("blocked")}}}); console.log(m.loadTasks());. For write fault on live UI: Storage.prototype.setItem=function(){throw new DOMException("blocked","QuotaExceededError")}. Restore only by closing the disposable profile. Toast target is 3000ms; accept manual timing from 2700 through 3800ms.
